messages.businessImpact: Users can download and run files that Windows and Edge would otherwise have warned them about, and can click past the warnings that do appear.
remediation: Enforce SmartScreen for Windows and for Edge, and prevent users from bypassing the warnings.
messages.cannotSee: Whether an assigned policy switches SmartScreen on is read, not whether it is doing anything: it protects against sites and downloads Microsoft has already judged, and says nothing about the rest. The browser has its own setting, so a tenant enforcing it in Edge and not through Windows is protected in the place it matters most and is reported here anyway. A setting this tool has no mapping for is not looked for at all and the rule is then not applicable rather than raised.
